background: Use case: precise-object-edit. Prepare a clean runtime background plate from the supplied horizontal game map. Preserve the open cream parchment book, its center crease and stitched edges, deep purple curtain surround, lantern and books at bottom left, gold hanging stars, subtle illustrated mountains/ruins along the page's upper and lower margins, bottom-right paper hills, exact 16:9 framing, warm paper lighting and texture. Remove ALL interactive UI: all map nodes including flag and boss, both character stickers, all routes/arrows/dashed connectors/checkmarks, all node tooltip/bubble panels and their text, all top hearts/currency/numbers, all four top bookmark tabs and home button. Reconstruct clean parchment where map routes/nodes were and curtain where the top UI was. At BOTTOM LEFT preserve the existing cream stitched legend ticket PANEL but remove EVERY icon and ALL text inside it; leave it completely blank. At bottom right remove the drag instruction ticket entirely and reconstruct the illustrated scenery behind it. Do not leave ghost outlines, icons, characters, text, coins, digits, navigation controls or route marks. The large inner book area should be quiet low-contrast blank parchment ready for dynamic nodes, but keep the existing subtle landscapes at its margins. Do not move, crop or redesign the book. One opaque landscape background plate.
nodes:
Use case: game UI asset atlas. Input is STYLE REFERENCE. Produce EXACTLY SIX separate round paper-seal map-node icons on TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Match the reference's die-cut cream parchment scalloped circular edge, dark plum circular inset, fine golden hairline, gentle cardstock texture and short shadows. Flat orthographic front view. Six icons arranged on an EXACT three-column by two-row evenly spaced GRID, no labels, no guide lines, no typography, no arrows, no checks, no numbers. Each icon centered in its equal cell and occupies about 72% of cell width/height; roomy clear transparent gutters, no overlap. Use 3:2 canvas, preferably 1536x1024 (six 512x512 cells).
TOP LEFT: battle, two crossed ivory swords on plum.
TOP CENTER: shop, little mint-green tent shop with dark roof on plum.
TOP RIGHT: rest, small warm orange campfire with ivory log shapes on plum.
BOTTOM LEFT: event, ivory open book with a single clear dark question mark on plum.
BOTTOM CENTER: reward, warm gold/cream treasure chest with clasp on plum.
BOTTOM RIGHT: boss, the same recognizable mischievous purple chibi dumpling from the reference, orange and cyan eyes, small golden ear rings, within the round plum seal; no humanoid body. 
All six share same circle size and basic border, no huge star burst beyond cell, no selected-state rings. All icon interiors are opaque, ONLY exterior is alpha transparent. No scene background, brown field, decorative sheet, lettering or watermark. The question mark is the only allowed textual symbol.
